# Code of Conduct

This project is a game with a player community, and it is maintained by one
person. Both facts matter here, so this is short and says what will actually
happen rather than describing a process nobody is staffed to run.

## The standard

Be decent to people. Concretely, in issues, pull requests, and anywhere else
this project is discussed:

- No harassment, personal attacks, or abuse — including toward other players.
- No slurs or demeaning comments about who someone is.
- No sexual attention or imagery.
- No posting someone's private information.
- Assume the person on the other end is trying, and disagree about the work
  rather than about them.

This is the substance of the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/),
which is the fuller statement if you want one.

## Reporting

Message a maintainer privately in the [Discord](https://discord.gg/bCQGs8r6SK).
Please do not put a report in a public issue — that is bad for the person
reporting and bad for the person reported.

Reports are read by one person, so a reply may take days rather than hours. It
will be read.

## What happens

Depending on what happened: a private word, edited or removed content, or a ban
from the repository, the Discord, or the game. In-game conduct is handled with
the same moderation tools as any other player behaviour.

Being a contributor does not earn extra latitude. If anything it earns less,
because contributors set the tone.
